test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70ef44ce20510fcf04e3f9bb6f3ebbb11dcabdfe47f0e634ff5be93d92cf1016.png]
solution:
As 6 is the common face on both the dice, keeping it constant and then rotating in clockwise direction, we get the faces opposite to each other:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07ca27437c3d606cfb57487eefe62086b9c8cc30922a38f96d979bd9e0df2869.png] 

 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
1

 
 
 
3

 
 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
2

 
 
 
5

 
 
 

Clearly, '2' will be the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

Hence, '**2**' is the correct answer.
